pages.text: Elemental beings much like the Blaze, except that this one is a creature of water, and the water bolts it fires are no small threat either.$(br)All such elementals share one trait in common, and it did not take you long to find a way to tame them.
It attacks by firing wave bolts; it does not rise into the air before shooting the way a Blaze does, but on water it can bob up and down.$(br)You can heal it with Bulge Powder.
